mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 6%, a sharp rise in housing starts signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% y-o-y when UNRATE < 6% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2%, a sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS drops > 100k m-o-m when FEDFUNDS > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals an inflation scare that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real sales of automobiles are rising, a sharp drop in the personal savings rate signals overextension of household balance sheets that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS drops > 5pp y-o-y when CPIAUCSL is rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
